annotations.title: Sketch a circle with a revolve axis

description: Add a sketch with a circle profile and a construction line. onshape_revolve spins the profile around that construction line, which is how you get a torus or a ring.

axis_end.description: Axis end. As [x, y] inches or "x,y".

axis_start.description: Axis start. As [x, y] inches or "x,y".

center.description: Circle centre. As [x, y] inches or "x,y".

elem.description: Element id (tab) — the <elem> segment of the document URL.

name.description: Feature name shown in the tree (default "Sketch circle and axis").

plane.description: Default plane to sketch on (default Front).

validate.description: Re-read the feature list afterwards and fail if the feature regenerated with an error (default true).

ws.description: Workspace id — the <ws> segment of the document URL.

name: onshape_sketch_circle_axis
title: Sketch a circle with a revolve axis
